findings.issue: Error branch references undefined `res` (`res.status`, `res.statusText`) — a failed API call throws ReferenceError instead of the intended ApiError; the turn-74 hot-fix corrected the adjacent line but not this one
findings.suggestion: Fix to `response.status`/`response.statusText` (or use the defined ApiError class), and add `tsc --noEmit` to the build/CI step

findings.issue: All application source was written via bash heredocs, which caused a shell syntax error (turn 83), a truncated heredoc (turn 85), and a duplicate append that broke the first build (turns 84/91)
findings.suggestion: Use dedicated file-write/edit tools for source files; if heredocs are unavoidable, write once and verify with a quick read/tail before building

findings.issue: First attempt to write src/routes/(home).ts failed on the unquoted path, so the data.ts append ran twice, leaving a duplicated getGenerationSpeciesIds export found only at build time
findings.suggestion: Re-run the full command rather than appending after partial failure; quote paths containing parentheses

findings.issue: ApiError class is defined but never used (dead code)
findings.suggestion: Use it in api() when !response.ok, or remove it

findings.issue: Zero typechecks across a TypeScript app; a single `tsc` run would have caught the surviving `res` bug
findings.suggestion: Add `npm run check` (tsc) and run it after each substantive edit, next to the build

findings.issue: Three turns spent probing for image tooling (PIL, ImageMagick, pip) that isn't installed before reaching the sharp solution
findings.suggestion: Check `npm i sharp` (or crop via the browser's screenshot clipping) first in a Node environment

findings.issue: Re-ran node/npm/package-version lookups because it doubted output it had just received, then again second-guessed the result in thinking
findings.suggestion: Trust captured tool output; record versions once and move on

summary: A disciplined, front-loaded session: spec, tests, design and the Gracile 0.11 package ecosystem were fully understood before any code was written, implementation went in dependency order, and the single test failure was root-caused and fixed in one cycle. Verification was unusually thorough — three full suite runs plus screenshot comparison against design references — though the never-run typecheck let a small latent bug (`res` in app/src/lib/api.ts:22) survive. The main inefficiency was writing all source via bash heredocs and python string-replace, which manufactured most of its own build failures.
